preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The string S must have at least one character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(len(S) - i for i in range(len(S)) if all(S[i] == S[j] for j in range(i, min(len(S), i + len(S) - i))))
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of similarities of the string S with each of its suffixes.
